title: Mapping NGFS Climate Pathways to GICS Sectors: Application to Portfolio Decarbonization
abstract: arXiv:2611.17942v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Portfolio climate alignment is limited by the mismatch between asset managers' sector classifications and those of climate scenarios. This article proposes an NGFS-GICS mapping based on the materiality of Scope 1 and 2 GHG emissions rather than on semantic similarity. The mapping feeds a Sectoral Decarbonization Approach that down-scales NGFS trajectories into GICS sector pathways at portfolio level, adjusted for regional exposure. Applied to two illustrative ETF indices, it shows how sectoral composition and regional trajectories shape a portfolio's financed emissions pathway. The framework is transparent, asset-class agnostic and usable for internal exercises such as climate stress tests.

translated_title: 将NGFS气候路径映射至GICS行业：在投资组合脱碳中的应用
translated_abstract: 投资组合的气候对齐工作受到资产管理公司行业分类与气候情景行业分类之间不匹配的制约。本文提出了一种基于范围1和范围2温室气体排放重要性（而非语义相似性）的NGFS-GICS映射方法。该映射为行业脱碳方法（SDA）提供输入，将NGFS气候轨迹下推至投资组合层面的GICS行业路径，并根据区域敞口进行调整。该方法应用于两个示例性ETF指数，展示了行业构成和区域轨迹如何塑造投资组合的融资排放路径。该框架透明、与资产类别无关，可用于气候压力测试等内部实践。
tldr: 本文提出基于温室气体排放重要性而非语义相似性的NGFS-GICS行业映射方法，将NGFS气候情景路径下推为投资组合层面的GICS行业脱碳路径，为气候压力测试等投资组合脱碳实践提供了透明且与资产类别无关的框架。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an NGFS-GICS sector mapping based on the materiality of Scope 1 and 2 GHG emissions rather than semantic similarity, enabling the down-scaling of NGFS climate pathways into GICS sector decarbonization pathways at portfolio level, providing a transparent and asset-class-agnostic framework for exercises such as climate stress tests.
